title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 4 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What do you think your best personal qualities are? [Why?]
Do you have the same personal qualities as your parents? [Why/Why not?]
What personal qualities are important to you in a friend? [Why?]
Do you think you have the personal qualities to be a good/successful leader? [Why/Why not?]

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a time when you had a long discussion about a news story.
cue_card_bullets: what the news story was about
who you discussed this news story with
and explain why you had such a long discussion about this news story

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: How do most people find out about the news in your country?
Are people more interested in local news than national news?
How important is it to know about international news?
Why are discussion programmes involving members of the public popular on TV and radio?
What kinds of people want to take part in discussion programmes?
Do discussion programmes influence people in a good or bad way?
